popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book III — the snakes, seven years as a woman, Hera's blinding, and Zeus' gift of prophecy that outlives sight.

popCulture.title: The Waste Land
popCulture.creator: T. S. Eliot
popCulture.description: Eliot's blind seer watches the modern city — Tiresias as the poem's dual-sexed witness to sterility and desire.

popCulture.title: Tiresias
popCulture.description: The Theban prophet who saw both sexes remains the name for insight bought by blindness.
